title: Wayfare Bikes and Scooters Ride Tariff by Plan
content:
Ride rates of the Wayfare Bikes and Scooters plans, in US dollars, per ride and per minute of riding.

## Tariff

| Plan | Unlock fee, per unlock of any vehicle | Classic bike minutes included per ride | Classic bike, per minute beyond the included minutes | E-bike free minutes per ride | E-bike, per minute beyond any free minutes | Most an e-bike ride's minute charges can total | Scooter, per minute | Discount for verified helmet use |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Bikes Pay As You Ride | 1.00 | 0 | 0.18 | 0 | 0.42 | no cap | 0.39 | 0.00 |
| Wayfare Bikes Day Pass | 0.00 | 180 | 0.18 | 0 | 0.42 | no cap | 0.39 | 0.00 |
| Wayfare Bikes Monthly Pass | 0.00 | 45 | 0.18 | 0 | 0.24 | no cap | 0.29 | 0.00 |
| Wayfare Bikes Access Annual | 0.00 | 60 | 0.05 | 0 | 0.05 | 3.00 | 0.05 | 0.00 |
| Wayfare Bikes Annual | 0.00 | 45 | 0.18 | 0 | 0.24 | no cap | 0.29 | 0.00 |
| Wayfare Bikes Annual Plus | 0.00 | 45 | 0.18 | 30 | 0.12 | no cap | 0.29 | 0.00 |

## Tariff notes

- **Unlock fee:** the charge for each unlock of any vehicle, classic bike, e-bike or scooter alike.
- **Classic bike included minutes:** the minutes of each classic bike ride that the plan includes. The classic per-minute rate is charged only on minutes beyond them.
- **E-bike free minutes:** e-bike minutes per ride included before per-minute charges begin; the e-bike rate is charged on minutes beyond any free e-bike minutes.
- **E-bike cap:** the most the minute charges of one e-bike ride can total. "No cap" means the plan sets no such limit.
- **Scooter rate:** the charge per scooter minute.
- **Helmet discount:** the discount for verified helmet use, which is 0.00 on every plan.

## Points of comparison drawn from the tariff

- Wayfare Bikes Pay As You Ride is the only plan with an unlock fee above 0.00; its fee is 1.00 per unlock.
- Wayfare Bikes Annual Plus is the only plan with free e-bike minutes: on that plan an e-bike ride of 30 minutes or less has no e-bike minute charge, and each minute from the thirty-first onward is charged 0.12.
- Wayfare Bikes Access Annual is the only plan with an e-bike cap: whatever the length of an e-bike ride, its minute charges on that plan total no more than 3.00. At 0.05 a minute, the cap is reached at 60 minutes of e-bike riding.
- The Day Pass includes 180 classic bike minutes per ride; the Monthly Pass, Annual and Annual Plus include 45; Access Annual includes 60; Pay As You Ride includes none.
